doc: WP12 tower on the combined ground (terrain + structure overlay): walk into the 80 degree lower wall, climb it, rest on the ledge until the wheel is full, climb the upper wall, mantle onto the top, then run off the far edge, jump, double jump, open the glider and glide away east, steer, close with G and fall to the ground. Generated by client/src/sim/golden/generate.ts on worldgen.wasm (collision_height, water_height). Replay: start at `initial` (staminaMax in fine units), apply each frame with dt and env, compare to states[i]. Row: [x,y,z,vx,vy,vz,airJumps,mode,stamina,timer,lunge,flags]. See client/src/sim/README.md.
